question: Which product category had the lowest gross margin percentage in 2025, and which product in that category sold the most units in 2025? Give the product's ID, name and units sold in 2025.
plan: The query only returned the product details and units sold, but omitted the name of the product category with the lowest gross margin percentage in 2025.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH cat_margin_2025 AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) AS gross_margin, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY (SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount))) ASC LIMIT 1), lowest_cat AS (SELECT category FROM cat_margin_2025) SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND p.category = (SELECT category FROM lowest_cat) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1
